verdict.rationale: BigQuery is a set-based SQL warehouse. DML statements update, insert and delete data across tables in single operations, and procedural language lets you chain multiple statements. Batch work is also covered: scheduled batch load jobs, the `bq` CLI, and an engine that processes terabytes in seconds. Missing for 10: explicit docs on bulk DML semantics and limits (e.g. row and statement quotas), evidence of agent-driven bulk operations via the MCP Toolbox or Gemini, and independent hands-on corroboration of large bulk mutations.
